# Pristine upstream bench.sh supervisor: source proposal

This replaces the raw-GEN performance controllers. It invokes unchanged
upstream bench.sh from the official pristine tree at7695859 with explicit
`--url http://127.0.0.1:PORT --long --runs 3 --out PRIVATE_ROOT`.
The same upstream client applies to official, Xe and local server comparisons.
No custom prompts, raw DONE parsing, timing formulas, token equality gates,
benchmark source modifications or client monkeypatching occur.

Main must review this packet before importing or executing anything. The author
performed no tests/import/AST/build/model/GPU/Git/service/process work. CPU
fixtures are proposed and unexecuted; they specifically check failed requests
hidden behind upstream client exit0 and actual calibrated prompt geometry.

Main launches ONE supervisor with the reviewed direct_owner.py hash
 a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f.
The supervisor starts its dedicated loopback server and upstream benchmark as
children in the SAME anchored session. It never instantiates another Owner.
Main's outer owner must retain pidfd/session identity, finite wall/CPU/RSS/file
budgets, final session-empty/reap evidence and fault/cleanup results. The outer
record is necessary for final qualification; supervisor success alone cannot
prove that the enclosing session has been reaped.

## Server shutdown observation

The upstream client's own stop_server uses numeric terminate, waits90s and then
kill without a final wait. Therefore explicit --url is used so pristine bench
never starts/stops a server or touches services.

`server-close-observer.py.txt` loads the pinned server module and calls its
original main. It wraps StrataEngine.close ONLY when shutdown begins, after
the supervisor observes idle and API in_flight0. A transparent stdin proxy
records successful original QUIT write/flush; an audit hook records any engine
fallback os.kill; the original close retains every wait and return unchanged.
No file in the server checkout is edited. No callback observes request timing.
This is server shutdown instrumentation, not a modified benchmark client.
Main must review this small wrapper and its transparent stream behavior.

The supervisor signals only its pinned server pidfd with TERM. Original server
SIGTERM follows KeyboardInterrupt and original engine.close. Actual QUIT
write+flush, engine returncode0, no fallback signal and normal server exit0 are
required. Every known descendant pidfd must indicate exit. Failed/active
requests or missing shutdown evidence remain failures; there is no retry,
unknown-owner kill, service operation or device reset.

## Main config

Supply --main-config and its exact SHA256. Schema is
`upstream-benchsh-supervisor-main-v1`; require main_reviewed=true.
Config specifies mode debug/quiet, deadline_seconds1800 or2400, dedicated port,
fresh absolute out under B, upstream_revision, explicit complete environment,
client_environment, utility_environment, health_environment, health_argv and
exact health_stdout (including selected provider library rows), server_python,
server, server_config, binary and binary_sha256, exact engine_argv, engine_log
inside out, engine_environment (complete actual expected environment),
mapped_libraries (path to sha256/stat identity), required_runtime_paths,
settings_reviewed=true and ordinary_serve_no_mtp_no_borrow_pipeline1_batch0=true.
All executable/provider/source/model/profile/config/input identities are pinned
in identities (path/sha256). This includes pristine bench.sh/client and .venv
Python, benchmark agent input documents, server module/helper closure, this
packet's supervisor/observer/mapping, provider and binary. Main prepares the
upstream .venv/bin/python launcher separately; this code never installs it.

reviewed_proofs pin Main's already-qualified source/build/provider/model proof
receipts. In particular local native-copy uses new binarybuild/free/strata
b54579b536962c7db7652503e0dcb50282ddbc667f290b90f101419b44778554,
current source410904c99d273435b5302fa8976cc667d17957f2 and actual compiled closure
main-native-copy-model-source-closure-root-v1/record.json. This supervisor
checks their existing reviewed closed status without falsely requiring known
host negative tests to exit0; Main's typed proof qualification remains separate.
Tiny GPU qualification cannot qualify full-context model behavior.

Main must pin actual safe server config/argv: context262144, int8 KV resident32768,
noGrow, noMTP, noBorrow, pipeline1/batch0, PCIefrac0/adapt0, cache128 with measured
effective144slots/281MiB, workers5/tasks18, prompt/conversation cache0. Do not
interpret slots144 as cache144MiB. The environment enforces source LLVM/URv2
selection through Main's complete pinned provider identity and fixed
DirectSubmission0/segmented1/deviceplan0/ring16/issuer0/leafevents0/nativebatch1
and residentgraph0. Main must disable browser opening, auto reload/switching,
cache-drop helpers and external logging in the server config. All engine raw
log files must remain within the fresh output budget root; engine_log names the
actual server-configured engine file. Main must verify actual config mapping,
not merely copy the stated settings into review booleans.

Debug requires parameter validation and STRATA_TRACE, warnings/errors without
UR tracing layers or successful API flooding. Quiet removes STRATA_TRACE and
validation. Run in separate fresh servers/output roots; debug is not ranked.

## Results and bounds

The supervisor preserves the original upstream results.json and report,
including individual request records, and inspects results.failures, clients
errors and the three actual32K request outcomes explicitly. Exit0 alone is not
success. All prompt token counts remain as upstream reports them. The official
calibrated32K row may fall just below32768; that case is recorded honestly and
is not marked eligible for a >=32768 timing comparison. Short/agent rows are
auxiliary; they are never labelled32K. No rates or medians are calculated here;
use upstream benchmark output. All HTTP success leaves model quality unevaluated.

Startup300s; whole supervisor1800/2400s; aggregate artifact/log64MiB;
bounded children512, thread census256 and polls25000. Fresh health/kernel gates
bracket model work. Devcoredump/fatal/runtime/reset messages stop the job;
fresh kernel entries are checked periodically and after completion/failure.
Main supplies outer-owner RAM/CPU caps and available memory/cgroup/device-idle
admission before launch. Existing owned-v0141-measurement.lock serializes work.

Successful server/API logs are not cleaned by this source. Main must extract
compact fault/lifecycle/provider evidence then retire redundant normal raw
logs with a path/hash/reason deletion manifest, preserving pristine upstream
per-request results. Failed diagnostics keep one representative mechanism.
No retained full successful API trace is required by this benchmark task.
